name: Conservative — weak market
notes: RSI(14) under 40 is only mildly weak, but a cautious holder wants cover before the fall is obvious -- so this fires early, buys the largest cover of the six bands, and holds it for 3 days.

name: Conservative — calm market
notes: RSI(14) over 40 is not weak, but a cautious holder still wants a smaller, shorter cover in place rather than none at all -- the same size and length that a balanced holder uses when the market turns weak, which is intended, not a coincidence. An RSI reading of exactly 40 matches neither band -- a known, accepted gap, not a bug.
